show.description: Cornered by a lie that she’s dating elusive billionaire Dev Raichand, Kashish must bring him to her best friend’s wedding or lose her friend and her job. She drags her runaway ex-fiancé Rahul back to play “Dev” for one night. The fake romance reignites old wounds, until the masquerade flips and the real Dev and their second chance stands revealed.
